summary: This episode discusses megatrends focusing on the space industry and plastic pollution. Space industry is seeing reduced costs for satellite launches with private companies like SpaceX, Google and Facebook entering. Major aerospace/defense companies like Boeing and Lockheed Martin are positioned to benefit from this trend. Plastic pollution presents significant environmental challenges but also investment opportunities in waste management and alternative materials.

Internet traffic expected to increase 60x by 2030, driving demand for satellite broadband
Plastic production has tripled since 1989, with only 14% recycled
Waste Management companies have outperformed the market recently
